title: Nayax to Report 2026 Q1 Earnings on May 12, 2026
summary: HERZLIYA, Israel, April 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Nayax Ltd. (Nasdaq: NYAX; TASE: NYAX), a global commerce enablement and payments platform designed to help merchants scale their business by simplifying payments and maximizing loyalty , today announced that it will release its earnings for the first quarter of 2026 on Tuesday, May 12, 2026, before U.S. markets open. Nayax will hold two calls, one in English and one in Hebrew. Nayax CEO and Chairman, Yair Nechmad, will speak alongside Nayax’s Chief Financial Officer, Sagit Manor, and Chief Strategy Officer, Aaron Greenberg. Conference Calls: The conference call in English will be held at: 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time / 3:30 p.m. Israel Time / 5:30 a.m. Pacific Time. The conference call in Hebrew will be held at: 9:30 a.m. Eastern Time / 4:30 p.m. Israel time / 6:30 a.m. Pacific Time.
